description: This is a rustic, terracotta-colored clay pot with a weathered, matte finish and a slightly irregular, handmade shape. It sits atop a flat, grey stone base and contains a cluster of large, crumpled green and white leaves.

This is a rustic, terracotta-colored ceramic pot with a weathered finish and a slightly tapered shape, containing a textured green and silver botanical arrangement. It sits upon a large, flat, gray stone base that features a circular indentation for the pot's bottom.

This is a terracotta-colored clay pot with a rustic, matte finish and a rounded base, resting on a flat, gray stone slab. It features a cluster of green and white variegated leaves growing from its top.

This is a rustic, earthenware-style pot with a textured, sandy-orange finish that shows natural variations in color and subtle weathering. It contains large, stylized green and grey leaves with marble-like patterns and sits atop a flat, grey, stone-like base.
A large, rounded terracotta-colored clay pot with a matte, slightly textured surface sits on a grey stone base. It is filled with green and grey variegated leaves that have a metallic or waxy sheen.
